# محظوظ (ma7zooz.com)

> منصة ألعاب مجانية بالعربية تُلعب مباشرة في المتصفح على الجوال والكمبيوتر، بلا تحميل وبلا تسجيل — ألعاب كلمات وذكاء وأرقام وأركيد وذاكرة وسباق.

ma7zooz.com (Ma7zooz / محظوظ) is a free Arabic-language browser-games site. Every game is HTML5 and plays instantly on both mobile and desktop, with no download and no signup. Game names are shown in both Arabic and English.

## Games
- [لغز الأرقام — Daily Code Breaker](https://ma7zooz.com/g-daily-code): daily 4-digit secret-number guessing puzzle in Arabic, with streaks and shareable results.
- [كلمة اليوم — Daily Word (Arabic Wordle)](https://ma7zooz.com/word): Arabic Wordle — guess the 5-letter word in 6 tries, with keyboard support, streaks and a share button.
- [سودوكو — Sudoku](https://ma7zooz.com/sudoku): classic 9x9 Sudoku with three difficulty levels and a timer.
- [2048 — 2048 Puzzle](https://ma7zooz.com/game2048): merge matching number tiles to reach 2048.
- [الأفعى — Snake](https://ma7zooz.com/snake): classic Snake with swipe and keyboard controls.
- [اجمع الحظ — Catch the Luck](https://ma7zooz.com/g-catch-luck): fast arcade catch-and-score game.
- [هكس محظوظ — Lucky Hex](https://ma7zooz.com/g-hextris): hexagonal Tetris-style arcade game.
- [أحجار محظوظ — Lucky Blocks](https://ma7zooz.com/g-blocks): classic falling-blocks stacking puzzle.
- [كانسة الألغام — Minesweeper](https://ma7zooz.com/minesweeper): classic Minesweeper logic game.
- [سباق سريع — Speed Dodge](https://ma7zooz.com/dodge): fast lane-dodging car game.
- [لعبة الذاكرة — Memory Match](https://ma7zooz.com/memory): card-matching memory game.
- [إكس أو — Tic-Tac-Toe](https://ma7zooz.com/tictactoe): Tic-Tac-Toe vs the computer (easy or unbeatable) or a friend.
- [أربعة في صف — Four in a Row](https://ma7zooz.com/fourinarow): Four in a Row vs the computer or a friend.
- [أحجية الأرقام — Sliding Puzzle](https://ma7zooz.com/slidepuzzle): sliding number puzzle (15 Puzzle), 3x3 or 4x4.
- [اضرب الخلد — Mole Smash](https://ma7zooz.com/molesmash): 30-second whack-a-mole style reflex game.
- [ذاكرة الألوان — Color Memory](https://ma7zooz.com/colormemory): sequence memory game with colors and tones.
- [اختبار السرعة — Reaction Time Test](https://ma7zooz.com/reaction): 5-attempt reaction time test with a share button.
